PATTERN: Memories are scoped to projects. When in whisnap-web, you see whisnap-web memories. When in whisnap-ios, you see whisnap-ios memories. No cross-pollination.
COMPONENTS: Global scope (personal/philosophy, shared everywhere, max 2 per retrieval) vs Project scope (technical, isolated per project)
WHY: Prevents noise, keeps project context clean.
REJECTED: Single unified memory pool - would surface irrelevant technical details across projects.
